stage: before opening or generating main held-out tests
preliminary_data_seen: Static validation and a seed-0 engineering smoke training using 10 validation worlds/type. Its checkpoint is discarded and seed 0 rerun using all 100 validation worlds/type.
main_platform: GRU PPO with exact finite-catalogue Bayesian posterior plus public block summaries
ablations: same GRU PPO on public history without posterior
same GRU PPO on time only
service_checkpoint_rule: validation average Q >= 0.95 validation original Q, maximize R among eligible checkpoints; if none, maximize Q then R
additional_fixed_reference: unconstrained per-type validation-best fixed rule, to avoid treating a stricter per-type-service oracle as a general static upper bound
statistical_analysis: 10000 paired crossed bootstrap draws, train-seed resampling and within-fixed-type world resampling; all seed results retained
exploratory_stress_tests: all 10 frozen main policies against exact myopic grand coalition
all 10 frozen main policies with tabular economic-class Q learners and correctly specified candidate replay, without platform retraining
all 10 frozen main policies with raw-rho feature learners and correctly specified candidate replay, without platform retraining
all 10 frozen main policies with hold extended from 200 to 1000 rounds
platform seeds 0,4,9 against an independently selected finite class of forward-looking coalition imitation attacks
not_claimed: per-path or per-type 95 percent service guarantee
runtime_equivalence_optimization: After round 200, evaluation stops updating the unused hypothesis bank, because the last threshold is irrevocably held. Revenue, allocations, buyer learning and all later cash flows still run. Training continues full posterior updates for the critic. Saved evaluation posterior is therefore the round-200 posterior.
